title: Price paid and value perceptions
summary: This topic centers on what owners paid, whether the price felt reasonable or worthwhile, and a few mentions of paid extras or charging costs, but many excerpts are too fragmentary to determine sentiment clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the price as reasonable or justified by satisfaction, performance, comfort, and included features.

negative.summary: Negative feedback reflects dissatisfaction with the ownership experience relative to a very high amount paid.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined excerpts mostly mention what was paid, added packages, charging costs, or purchase choice without enough context to classify the sentiment reliably.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are short and lack enough context to determine sentiment confidently.
The cluster mixes several loosely related price themes, including total purchase price, paid add-ons, charging expenses, and value-for-money remarks.
Some excerpts reference other brands or broader purchase context, which limits how specifically they describe the G70 itself.
